He served for 46 years in the Department.en: He served for 46 years in the Department of Civil Engineering at Kunsan National University, including as professor, dedicating himself to nurturing the next generation of scholars, and was awarded the Order of Service Merit with Yellow Stripes. After retirement, he pursued photography, creating works of profound philosophy and artistry centered on water and light.

Depois de se aposentar, dedicou-se à fotografia e criou obras de profunda filosofia e sensibilidade artística, centradas na água e na luz.
